","color":"","numCell":false,"dataCellDiffId":"8c2963fc-8dc5-4b9d-8d53-9f760665bd5a","nodeId":"8cd939b4999446a2b0747faf10e3ab58"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a97eebfc-0b7b-4014-9003-578a82a67dea","nodeId":"48016a20842d4720a7b77742b56bb51d"}}]}]}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"30209dd0-f571-4bbb-a97c-b830523a5997","nodeId":"04524e27ef204b6dbd5fc44af1b2e0a6"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a598cdf3-8cb1-41ce-9082-4ac558f377b2","nodeId":"a80a4b46b48f4836b8d261e6d269f91b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"管控依据："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6681e504-b908-4652-94b2-b93bdf24f41c","nodeId":"1894859fa50f447fa003f112f0dfb0dc"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络安全法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"51403f53-9efa-46e2-8c4c-60b4d9d53fad","nodeId":"279cd1a356db4568a27eea9759562030"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第十二条　国家保护公民、法人和其他组织依法使用网络的权利，促进网络接入普及，提升网络服务水平，为社会提供安全、便利的网络服务，保障网络信息依法有序自由流动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"875028d4-1ccb-4e65-905f-d987582ea377","nodeId":"d423b10e3c3c41a591e0674e23bbe496"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"任何个人和组织使用网络应当遵守宪法法律，遵守公共秩序，尊重社会公德，不得危害网络安全，不得利用网络从事危害国家安全、荣誉和利益，煽动颠覆国家政权、推翻社会主义制度，煽动分裂国家、破坏国家统一，宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义，宣扬民族仇恨、民族歧视，传播暴力、淫秽色情信息，编造、传播虚假信息扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序，以及侵害他人名誉、隐私、知识产权和其他合法权益等活动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4302a042-f08b-4fcf-90a7-968cab01da01","nodeId":"be7c5335c29d400298dfb1c01bc3fca9"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第三十一条　国家对公共通信和信息服务、能源、交通、水利、金融、公共服务、电子政务等重要行业和领域，以及其他一旦遭到破坏、丧失功能或者数据泄露，可能严重危害国家安全、国计民生、公共利益的关键信息基础设施，在网络安全等级保护制度的基础上，实行重点保护。关键信息基础设施的具体范围和安全保护办法由国务院制定。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"1ed0e9d7-0398-4527-9019-f4c827393a6c","nodeId":"e2cf4b783e694e50bd96817564188523"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"国家鼓励关键信息基础设施以外的网络运营者自愿参与关键信息基础设施保护体系。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"3aa6bf99-a927-4583-8618-06effe31e669","nodeId":"b72b2ddf7e1d426b93d29e7113fc8188"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"地图管理条例"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4d69086a-bcd0-415c-bc49-076a34be4071","nodeId":"477367c71d83431eb015fe7eba74f10e"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"《地图管理条例》第八条规定，地图上不得表示下列内容：（一）危害国家统一、主权和领土完整的；（二）危害国家安全、损害国家荣誉和利益的；（三）属于国家秘密的；（四）影响民族团结、侵害民族风俗习惯的；（五）法律、法规规定不得表示的其他内容。"},{"type":"hard_break"},{"type":"text","text":"《地图管理条例》第十五条规定，国家实行地图审核制度。向社会公开的地图，应当报送有审核权的测绘地理信息行政主管部门审核。但是，景区图、街区图、地铁线路图等内容简单的地图除外。地图审核不得收取费用。"},{"type":"hard_break"},{"type":"text","text":"《地图管理条例》第二十四条规定，任何单位和个人不得出版、展示、登载、销售、进口、出口不符合国家有关标准和规定的地图，不得携带、寄递不符合国家有关标准和规定的地图进出境。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b2322309-46ac-4936-9c02-68eb203428d2","nodeId":"c95cd2097069477085a1282354641534"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络信息内容生态治理规定"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"437aa103-67bf-4504-a287-579b95a3675d","nodeId":"83acfa8042ce4caf8b74bad425fc39b2"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第六条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者不得制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的违法信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"99e72845-89b3-4793-a6ec-dd74f00f5043","nodeId":"6e5f9bb405854c7ab083042f57f6cb03"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）反对宪法所确定的基本原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"eb329033-95b8-4ed8-9006-ed9ebe470627","nodeId":"62a9ed6ace5848d6b7970e988d669797"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（二）危害国家安全，泄露国家秘密，颠覆国家政权，破坏国家统一的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"505e4e47-38bd-47c8-a6b4-9491f67efe41","nodeId":"cb6e99d180bf4f1e8ccae21eff6ad559"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（三）损害国家荣誉和利益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b21dbf21-f423-4a11-97ee-ab585da3f279","nodeId":"3f93ae39d3404a30876e6620bb164038"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）歪曲、丑化、亵渎、否定英雄烈士事迹和精神，以侮辱、诽谤或者其他方式侵害英雄烈士的姓名、肖像、名誉、荣誉的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"5b6457c8-5815-49d1-be81-d0a22d02b57a","nodeId":"f2ae29f15d4b44438185b6356aa298f1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义或者煽动实施恐怖活动、极端主义活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"7e683287-4f2b-4ba7-b8ef-a4b4a714d9c8","nodeId":"9cf8323d65024d778017984059b6230e"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）煽动民族仇恨、民族歧视，破坏民族团结的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"e81ad0b2-367e-48d5-a344-a8fe32715b6f","nodeId":"30f3ed4c126d48c88973c055a6e0bf3c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）破坏国家宗教政策，宣扬邪教和封建迷信的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"65c85643-a386-4469-88e9-9af037ad7dc9","nodeId":"0cd54d15d3f342f58ed532ecbaba00dd"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）散布谣言，扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"8019809e-f181-4f22-8094-5b30ae5cdbf6","nodeId":"7984160b438a4f4f9f1c8b9bbb379e38"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）散布淫秽、色情、赌博、暴力、凶杀、恐怖或者教唆犯罪的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"8876f0e3-55f1-42e2-a794-13f9cfcaf31a","nodeId":"2983e18265da4c61bca9bb831eb35bf2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十）侮辱或者诽谤他人，侵害他人名誉、隐私和其他合法权益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"33f1d986-70de-43b9-bfb7-e747b34db257","nodeId":"28fcd6b247834e7ca70cd88b7bc66587"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十一）法律、行政法规禁止的其他内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"f0ca6642-30ee-42b1-870f-49470b97d093","nodeId":"22747b742575457196cabfbf57f0df24"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"8848b269-e891-491f-a04f-9add58a9752f","nodeId":"ce9f583ac06c4c8aa1bbc06b317a07a4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第五十一条冒充国家机关工作人员或者以其他虚假身份招摇撞骗的，处五日以上十日以下拘留，可以并处五百元以下罚款;情节较轻的，处五日以下拘留或者五百元以下罚款。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"ac2a1269-0bad-4fcd-af76-aa6485640927","nodeId":"e29c6ec9e2cf442ab6100d8ec01d85bf"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"冒充军警人员招摇撞骗的，从重处罚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6b43c12e-e557-42ad-921a-a5fb4faa35b5","nodeId":"de1105c671c547d186888bb05068a695"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"广告法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"ca4dd75c-4ee8-44a9-a40a-4c16afde18de","nodeId":"76cdd78acb584bbeb76bc8af519791c5"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第七条　广告内容应当有利于人民的身心健康，促进商品和服务质量的提高，保护消费者合法权益，遵守社会公告和职业首先，维护国家的尊严和利益。广告不得有下列情形："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"9e699e05-05d6-4eb0-84e4-e658b5b22408","nodeId":"a223c9aaa1524e2ebb9483b9bc6f7bbf"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    "},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（一）使用中华人民共和国国旗、国徽、国歌；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"529eb957-5e81-48e1-b66d-1ae15d0140a9","nodeId":"b55b0476f2414244aafc4a38b2b0db7d"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"    （二）使用国家机关和国家机关工作人员的名义；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"35b21972-247e-4aa0-8f56-52aa657bfb82","nodeId":"c81a4f78d88a47bd8b4cc396d485d413"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    （三）使用国家级、最高级、最佳等用语；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"f4891c3b-4532-4366-850e-cccec33f184f","nodeId":"f49d7551048a405c993347b4614bdc81"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    （四）妨碍社会安定和危害人身、财产安全，损害社会公共利益。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"606811e7-5c7c-4c52-9c9a-6745d32d1b82","nodeId":"ecccb17f7fe140289036e53fd6dd7e4b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    （五）妨碍社会公共秩序和违背社会良好风尚；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"f90edb23-74d0-45e1-b77b-b8641c9b71a6","nodeId":"1c86501a85fb4bc298f53ec672e848a7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    （六）含有淫秽、迷信、恐怖、暴力、丑恶的内容；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"00d92db4-e6a2-48b1-9be3-3a738a01cd7f","nodeId":"ea270dcf800a43828deb9d8e05bb5986"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    （七）含有民族、种族、宗教、性别歧视的内容；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"64f60238-a4a7-4d74-9a06-0a670c30b780","nodeId":"349229fa36ab4dd59755a3c5206de59f"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    （八）妨碍环境和自然资源保护；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"-webkit-left","dataDiffId":"2c8d5562-474f-4deb-94c0-ab6e1115eaf3","nodeId":"7463e178faeb433ca82702b4a1ee281d"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"    （九）法律、行政法规规定禁止的其他情形。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"73ac1ca6-31b8-4c09-b472-136672504b8b","nodeId":"643cf5fdb3a44c36b8aa523ad96b533b"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"《国旗法》"},{"type":"text","text":"第二十条规定，“国旗及其图案不得用作商标、授予专利权的外观设计和商业广告，不得用于私人丧事活动等不适宜的情形。”"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"5de69f27-622a-47c1-aa34-4eee7dfa7157","nodeId":"491b733140be474891ecb3faf4efd409"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"《国徽法》"},{"type":"text","text":"第十三条第一项第二项规定，国徽及其图案不得用于“商标、授予专利权的外观设计、商业广告”和“日常用品、日常生活的陈设布置”。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"f7041390-311d-4bdb-b8be-b3900a860484","nodeId":"d0e031571bca49eb873231c7f51d9f04"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"《党旗党徽》"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"3df7d1c7-0aa2-49b2-9802-5ab5bd66c79a","nodeId":"f1be01d6c3bb4ca2accb88016361f38c"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"党徽图案的可以使用情形"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"d0f269b8-1aac-4924-a5f9-8754f18f4441","nodeId":"121d8376a343478a8864004575ec4e07"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　（一）党内重要会议、重要活动使用的证件、标识等；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"1c8bc046-4759-41a5-8170-82b9eeae7a29","nodeId":"88d16cd3aa9641a2a5b4526fa43d1ee1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　（二）党的各级组织颁发的奖章、徽章、奖状、证书和其他荣誉性文书、证件，制作的有关工作证件等；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"9de6f024-66fa-4484-b038-2d89de70728d","nodeId":"010c823b0e69456eb3de102f68ffcb27"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　（三）党内重要出版物、宣传品等；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f4f729d4-7157-4c47-8e26-2b16dec5b2f1","nodeId":"eb0a7b10df7944ec969a3b3990e47a40"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　（四）党的各级组织的网络网站；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"ffb5ab23-6631-4300-99f6-5251e1ebe6b4","nodeId":"89b40390081a4739b335ba3dc63b4be7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　（五）党员教育基地、党员先锋岗、党建宣传栏（墙），以及党群服务中心、党员活动室等基层党组织活动场所；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"ae9d1b09-7822-453b-b6b0-fce84d8689b7","nodeId":"7afe327b730c42bbbd3258bfba38a7b3"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　（六）开展党的对外交往活动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6bf060fc-de1c-4fb5-813f-8c97e68ccdcb","nodeId":"752b39b5e27743279a94f5b8080b33de"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"《商标法》"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b34b24b0-02c8-4312-8136-5b6e6e3ae821","nodeId":"1d8cd9bd8e4845c080098bd2aa052b9d"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）将国旗国徽及其图案，以及相近似的标志作商标使用的，属于违反《商标法》第十条第一款第一项规定之情形，市场监管部门应当依照《商标法》第五十二条予以查处。即：予以制止，限期改正，并可以予以通报，违法经营额五万元以上的，可以处违法经营额百分之二十以下的罚款，没有违法经营额或者违法经营额不足五万元的，可以处一万元以下的罚款。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"fbb6612a-99bf-4cf8-a7d5-975f14a6ee3a","nodeId":"794904219d854f4398cfdb197d11f768"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"党政机关、事业单位和社会组织网上名称管理暂行办法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"ab9d87b6-3e39-475c-a4b6-90100bc6f5df","nodeId":"82957eb6d5654dccb10d96f298a3de33"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"0843fcf3-bea2-40a9-bd22-e151cbae9ba8","href":"https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%85%9A%E6%94%BF%E6%9C%BA%E5%85%B3%E3%80%81%E4%BA%8B%E4%B8%9A%E5%8D%95%E4%BD%8D%E5%92%8C%E7%A4%BE%E4%BC%9A%E7%BB%84%E7%BB%87%E7%BD%91%E4%B8%8A%E5%90%8D%E7%A7%B0%E7%AE%A1%E7%90%86%E6%9A%82%E8%A1%8C%E5%8A%9E%E6%B3%95/13217537","title":"https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%85%9A%E6%94%BF%E6%9C%BA%E5%85%B3%E3%80%81%E4%BA%8B%E4%B8%9A%E5%8D%95%E4%BD%8D%E5%92%8C%E7%A4%BE%E4%BC%9A%E7%BB%84%E7%BB%87%E7%BD%91%E4%B8%8A%E5%90%8D%E7%A7%B0%E7%AE%A1%E7%90%86%E6%9A%82%E8%A1%8C%E5%8A%9E%E6%B3%95/13217537","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"3b16473ef18d4dfa96e871548f7a84ce"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%85%9A%E6%94%BF%E6%9C%BA%E5%85%B3%E3%80%81%E4%BA%8B%E4%B8%9A%E5%8D%95%E4%BD%8D%E5%92%8C%E7%A4%BE%E4%BC%9A%E7%BB%84%E7%BB%87%E7%BD%91%E4%B8%8A%E5%90%8D%E7%A7%B0%E7%AE%A1%E7%90%86%E6%9A%82%E8%A1%8C%E5%8A%9E%E6%B3%95/13217537"}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"fcb18c58-085c-4147-8099-8b422c4d7207","nodeId":"06babfe4e86e46a8b9ec8f9cea5ce24c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第二十五条 对于抢注、盗用、冒用或造成党政机关、事业单位和社会组织的网上名称不能被正常解析、解析错误的组织和个人，管理机构和服务机构应当立即停止解析并注销其网上名称，告知相关机构依法追究其法律责任。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c284dcb4-d32e-4723-b1fc-49bcc304d0cf","nodeId":"33bbc1d3f94b4894bb83d62cb8249d81"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"中国少年先锋队章程"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"514cf909-7ca7-4cc6-a4bd-bcf1c53f0490","nodeId":"126fc64c219e460aa468a851369abf9b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"我们的标志：红领巾。它代表红旗的一角，是革命先烈的鲜血染成。每个队员都应该佩戴它和爱护它，为它增添新的荣誉。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"71019932-eef8-4a8c-a388-0406f55a5441","nodeId":"ee21d4c997d44f8dba83971cc2f2e941"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"人民币图样使用管理办法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b54ab778-6889-4174-ad43-32be63e94de2","nodeId":"cb077f18e4464964b8ac0bfe2284dfd3"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第十六条"},{"type":"text","text":"  有下列行为之一的，由中国人民银行或其分支机构给予警告，并按照《中华人民共和国中国人民银行法》第四十四条的规定予以处罚："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"27e88abf-b3f0-48fa-a0c4-3f2be2091a06","nodeId":"21d0feca2fd94321971cc5a153573630"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）违反本办法规定，未经许可使用人民币图样的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b619edf9-194c-4217-bdf4-e2057d900806","nodeId":"bc21dad6f48741cbbd6f3d238ac10313"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）违反本办法第四条，在祭祀用品、生活用品、票券上使用人民币图样的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"1ac887b9-1b02-4b4a-92a5-60b39c06c601","nodeId":"e4d4d17e29e6495e912ef20143c9a71a"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）违反本办法第九条，未按规定使用人民币图样的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a9b60fd4-e887-48b0-93dc-2ef078a741e9","nodeId":"fa3b0d93f17541928f88682273e6afae"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）违反本办法第十条，未按要求将相关材料报审批机构备案的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"534c0f25-5ec2-462c-a1cf-1f51458134cd","nodeId":"b8edfd82758540e4a4b52bcf6c5df8dc"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）违反本办法第十一条，未按照许可批准文件核准的范围使用人民币图样、使用人民币图样与申请事项不一致或者未在使用人民币图样时注明规定信息的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"51481791-45d8-4759-91aa-2a00f8c166a4","nodeId":"34c62063f615426f8b8b262c4be7c175"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）违反本办法第十二条第一款，转让人民币图样使用许可，涂改、倒卖、出租、出借人民币图样使用许可批准文件的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"d0d97669-f37a-44bd-8261-6be7771ae6a2","nodeId":"c61b87a0f2ea4b4592a7d06fbf72a232"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"六部门通告：禁止销售“军”字号烟酒等商品"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"015d89ed-2ba2-440c-86af-aeb12654834c","nodeId":"b72f058a1b8d4389b421c57dcefd2972"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"通告明确，“军”字号烟酒等商品，指在商品或包装上印刷、刻制、铸造包括但不限于下列字样或者图案，易误导消费者、造成涉军负面影响的商品。而军事单位名称，则包括中央军委、各战区、各军兵种、武装警察部队及其他军队单位的全称或者简称。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f5469abd-02ec-49c8-88e8-932a4a8666d9","nodeId":"43de209537604055a3176a16c5bf6dff"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　通告还明确，涉军特定含义字样，包括“军队”“部队”“解放军”“武警”“战区”“警卫局”“PLA”“CAPF”“PAP”“国防”“八一”“军用”“军供”“军中”“军需”“军服”“军品”“军队专供”“军队特供”“军队特制”“军品代销”“军品专营”等。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"e7897014-75ac-4cea-bbff-ae449ab796cc","nodeId":"a9f34ecb0b4e4e8cba8a360a058e3652"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　通告称，相关职能部门要密切配合，加强对违规生产、销售“军”字号烟酒等商品和涉军商标注册监管，对发现的问题坚决予以纠正，对拒不整改、顶风违法违规的，依法依规严肃查处。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c74bbc18-0652-4111-81dd-8bebaae83019","nodeId":"a821c72d1bd34f0396ba46cf832a8894"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"《中华人民共和国刑法》"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"e2ded122-269c-4589-9af8-e71ff39767b9","nodeId":"82d63e094f6b41dca23e881e2bdb1241"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第二百七十九条招摇撞骗罪冒充国家机关工作人员招摇撞骗的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役、管制或者剥夺政治权利;情节严重的，处三年以上十年以下有期徒刑。"},{"type":"hard_break"},{"type":"text","text":"冒充人民警察招摇撞骗的，依照前款的规定从重处罚"}]}]}
